Description
Our client, a fast-growing distributor of consumer electronics and smart home products headquartered in Warsaw, supplies retailers and e-commerce platforms in 14 European countries from three distribution centres in Poland, the Czech Republic and Germany. Revenue has doubled since 2022, and the planning processes have not kept pace: forecast accuracy is below 60 % at SKU level, inventory has grown faster than sales and service levels to key accounts are volatile.

We are looking for an experienced interim S&OP Lead who redesigns the monthly S&OP cycle and runs it together with the internal planning team until a permanent Head of Planning is on board.

Your responsibilities
- Assess the current planning process, roles and tools and design the target S&OP / IBP process (product review, demand review, supply review, integrated reconciliation, executive S&OP)
- Run the first six S&OP cycles and coach the demand and supply planners (team of 9)
- Improve statistical forecasting and introduce forecast value added (FVA) tracking
- Define inventory targets and safety stock policies by segment together with Finance
- Align the S&OP with the budget and the rolling forecast
- Support the selection of an advanced planning tool (shortlist: Kinaxis, o9, SAP IBP)

Requirements
- 8+ years in supply chain planning, of which at least 3 years designing or leading S&OP processes
- Strong background in demand planning and inventory optimisation
- Experience in distribution, retail or consumer goods
- Hands-on analytical skills (Excel with Power Query, Power BI; Python is a plus)
- Fluent English; Polish is not required

Conditions
- Start: 1 November 2026, 6 months with an option to extend
- 100 % remote, no travel required; an optional kick-off workshop in Warsaw can be arranged (travel costs covered)
- Rate: 110 € per hour, 40 hours per week
- Freelance contract with Vistula Supply Advisory as the prime contractor
